Dragonire Bay NR Station Stop is a station of SLT Line 3501 and Line 3502. It is located at Los Sengas Odyssey. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Sava Line, Odyssey Circular (Dragonire Bay Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Climb behind the Lavatories.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Dragon Head.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be bulit on Odyssey, as well as the first station to vastly use Underwater Materials, such as Sea Lanterns in place of Glowstone, and Prismarine Bricks.[1]
  • Concrete barriers are set up behind the staircases leading to the platforms. This design has implied that this station will have an interchange in the future.
  • The marine elements of this station allude to Sisu, the water dragon from the movie Raya and the Last Dragon.[2]
  • This Station is the first station to undergo expansion in 2025.

History[]

  • May 26 2021: This station began services alongside Sava Line.
  • March 4 2025: This station began expansion. At the same day, this station completed expansion.
  • March 5 2025: Odyssey Circular extends from Fishpond Vale Station to this station.
  • July 2 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.
  • September 25 2025: All existing exits are named.[3]

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 4
  • It is mandatory to turn on all particles before getting this Station Souvenir.
  • Take note of the four hints at the Concourse of this station. They are denoted in the increasing order.
  • Find in ascending order the number of bricks that have water dropping from it in each Exit Passageway. Then, click the buttons corresponding to that Exit Passageway.
  • Access the Station Souvenir through an entering from the West Outer Ring Elevator.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a potion.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Notes
    • Water

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Make use of the floor signs beneath the glass to find the corresponding button set from each platform.
  • One of the groups require you to answer the number of the cave from which water flows out, and another group requires you to count the number of caves from which water flows. A third group requires you to choose the wool that does not fit the hints.
  • Check the direction of floor water flow in one of the hints to check if you have missed anything.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a water bottle.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first Island Station ever built. They are characterised by large platform passageways behind the platforms, as well as the irregularity of the passageways. However, the narrow platforms and platform passageways of Island Stations stem from the design of the Underground Southern Line Stations in Terracept Division.[2]
  • This Station is the first station to undergo expansion in 2018.

History[]

  • May 11 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • April 4 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • February 23 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[4]
  • June 21 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • January 3 2018: This station completed expansion of the Interisland Line section.
  • January 6 2018: Interisland Line extends from Coubird Island Station to this station.[6]
  • July 25 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • February 22 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[8]

Fun Facts[]

  • There had been plans to serve Peckern South-East Coast Line before at this station, but Cities Transit has decided to abandon the plan.
  • The Peckern City Circular platforms of this station starts at Y=70, turns to the left hand side relative to the direction of travel of the train, then gradually climbs to Y=73, where the train stops, before proceeding to climb to Y=76 and turning back to the right hand side relative to the direction of travel until the axis of tracks has been reached. In summary, the platforms of this station can be seen as an island platform and a side platform at the same time.

Dumbbell Plateau Station is a station on Oasis Bay Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to PTT. Railway Greenwood Line (Dumbbell Plateau Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the fact that, at the time of its construction, it is situated between two snowy mountains in a fashion similar to a Dumbbell. However, the "Dumbbells" had disappeared due to initial development in surrounding areas for a while until a reconstruction has been done to recover the "Dumbbells" mountains.
  • This Station adopts the design style of Oasis Bay Line Stations with regards that the concourse and the platform uses the same space while water pillars flow from the side walls.

History[]

  • February 12 2019: This Station began services. West Oasis Bay Line is established.
  • December 22 2019: Oasis Bay Line merges with West Oasis Bay Line.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is The Endless Ochre.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Confluence of the Inner Lands".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
The Endless Ochre 02:44
Dust Beyond the Horizon 03:10

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to the Dune Sea on Tatooine in the movie series Star Wars.[2] However, as the desert at which this station is located is even larger, the term "Ocean" is used instead of "Sea". Coincidentally, there is another player in Project Nazca that uses the name "Ocean", and this station is built in tribute of that player.[3] To allude to the name "Ocean", Cyan Wool is used in this station.
  • The Confined Space between the Platforms of this station alludes to the Confined Space Between the Stadium Line and Bravo Line Platforms at Virtel Heights Station.

History[]

  • September 21 2017: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • September 22 2017: This station began services.
  • March 25 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Durandal Station is a station on Daring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the original name of this station was Empyrean Station, as this station was at a considerable distance away from the Nagasora development area, the new name of this station is taken from a nearby street of the same name. However, it should also be noted that, on March 2022, Labyrinth Line built Nagasora Station at the actual development area in Nagasora.
  • The name of this station refers to a sword of the Same Name that is used by the Frankish Military Leader Roland in the Matter of France Stories. However, the Chinese Name of this station is a re-translation from the Typical Chinese Name.
  • The blocks of gold in this station is an answer to the blocks of diamond used in Blu Trove Bay Station and the blocks of gold which also appeared in Centopia. Moreover, the blocks of gold also took reference from the sword at the nearby park.[2]
  • Centopia (District), or the future Nazca Railway Headquarters, is located three kilometers directly to the north of this station on a pill-shaped artificial island. Due to the longer distance travelled, trains also accelerate when leaving this station from the north.
  • The bridge support pillars to the north of this station contains blocks of diamond and blocks of quartz, an indicator that the trains are approaching or leaving Centopia from its south. However, the bridge support pillars to the south of Platform 3 (Centopia Depot) are normal bridge pillars.
  • As the Bus Station outside Exit A already existed before the existance of this station, Exit A is adjusted to the same width as the Bus Station.

History[]

  • July 12 2020: This station began services.

Dusty Station is a station on Abyss Line and Delta Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Punctual. Passengers may also use this station to change to Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line (Archwood Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The Design and name of this station alludes to the main protagonist in the Disney Animated Movie Planes of the Same Name.[3][4]
  • Before the establishment of Abyss Line, this station was one of the two stations in Nazca Railway that is only served by a single Veloduct (Delta Line) line, with the other being Zootuary Station, which is still only served by a single line to this day.
  • While the Exits and the Abyss Line Platforms are at the same altitude of Y=70, as the Abyss Line Platforms are situated above a canal, the Abyss Line Section of this Station is considered an Elevated Station.

History[]

  • January 27 2018: This station began services alongside Delta Line, but Abyss Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • April 7 2018: Abyss Line extends from Blue Swamp Station to this station.

Eagle East Beach Station was a station on Eagle Light Rail Line 1 and Line 2. It would have been operated by Ender Railway, and would have been located at Los Sengas Eagle Island. It was proposed to be an insert station between Eagle Island NR Station Station and Eagle Shopping Mall Station. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • One player is enough
  • Swim up one of the water pillars of the Memorial.
  • You have to walk a really long distance, but there are no branches, so go forward.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a feather.

Fun Facts[]

  • For all Arcgo Line Stations within West Metropolis Archipelago, a body of water behind a pane of glass is used for identification. In this station, all planes are replaced by panes of glass.
  • This station is the last station to be built within the West Metropolis Archipelago in Season 1, and had originally been planned to be the last station to be built within West Metropolis Archipelago. As a result, a memorial is set up at this station.

History[]

  • December 20 2015: This station began services.
  • September 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • August 23 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]

Earn Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. This island completed development on April 19 2017, and is one of the quickest islands to complete development in West Metropolis Archipelago.

Contents

  • 1 Facilities
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Peckern Transit
    • 2.3 Earn Island Light Rail
  • 3 History
  • 4 Citations and References

Facilities[]

North Zone
  • Earnock Estate: A mid-sized public housing estate designed to house at least 1'100 residents.
  • Earnock Place: The shopping mall for Earnock Estate.
  • Earn Island Ferry Pier: A privately-run pier that provides ferry services to neraby islands in West Metropolis Archipelago.
  • Earn Island Underground Cave System: A natural cave system discovered by the island owner. One of the landmarks of Earn Island.
  • Earn Island Station: Provides Nazca Railway Services with Interisland Line and Gondola Line
South Zone
  • Earn University: A mid-sized, professionally certified university that provides 250 academic degrees each year. It is split into four faculties, namely the faculty of Engineering, the faculty of Science, the faculty of Arts and the faculty of Design.
  • Essex College: A small-scaled secondary school that provides subjects for HKDSE. It provides 40 quotas for students each year.
  • South Island Prison: The first maxiumum security prison in Los Sengas. It can house up to 108 inmates.
  • Earn Island Municipal Building: A mid-sized municipal building that provides a library, a clinic and a community hall.
  • Earn Island Station (PT): Provides Peckern Metro Services with Northland Line.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • Interisland Line, Gondola Line Earn Island Station

Peckern Transit[]

  • Northland Line Earn Island Station

Earn Island Light Rail[]

  • Centre Line, University Line Earn University Station
  • Centre Line City Centre Station
  • Centre Line Earn Island Ferry Pier Station
  • Centre Line, Northern Line Earnock (S) Station
  • Centre Line Earnock (N) Station
  • Northern Line Earnock (C) Station
  • Northern Line Earnorth Station
  • University Line Essex College Station
  • University Line South Island Station

History[]

  • February 1 2017: Earn Island began development.
  • March 27 2017: Earnock Estate completed construction.
  • April 18 2017: Earn University complete.
  • April 19 2017: South Island Prison complete. Development complete.

Earn Island Station is a station on Interisland Line and Gondola Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Earn Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Northland Line (Earn Island Station) and Earn Island Light Rail Centre Line (City Centre Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the permanent Up Direction Terminus of Gondola Line.
  • At the time of the construction of this station, plans are already in place to build an Interisland Line Spur starting from this station that does NOT go to Edward Island. However, the plan likely only involved Platform 1 as it was explicitly mentioned that Platforms 4 and 5 were used as short-range train platforms.[5]
  • The original plans of the Interisland Line Spur Line and subsequently Gondola Line involved the trains stopping at Cajotine Island Station. However, due to insufficient space on Cajotine Island, plans to set up a station on that island were ultimately scrapped, and trains would go to Decajotine Island Station instead.[6]
  • This Station is the first station in Los Sengas Division to feature an In-Station Transit, and the In-Station Transit is built in the style of Terracept Division Stations. However, the first station to feature an In-Station Transit in Nazca Railway is Terracept Terminal, and it was known as the Terracept Internal People Mover.[7][8]

History[]

  • May 19 2018: This Station completed construction.[9]。
  • May 20 2018: This Station began services alongside Interisland Line. At the time of Construction of this station, all five platforms were used by Interisland Line.
  • October 28 2018: Gondola Line is established, and Platforms 1, 4, and 5 of this station are given to that line. While Platforms 1, 4 are used for boarding, Platform 5 is used for alighting.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Go Outside the gate area and go to the connecting passageway between this station and White Margin Station.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Snowball.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in 2016.
  • This station is the first Floating Station ever built.
  • This station is the first and currently the only station to use Open PSDs in Los Sengas Division.
  • This station the has the platforms with the highest altitude in Los Sengas Division at Y=115 and still holds this height to this day.
  • A junction is built to the south of this station.

History[]

  • January 1 2016: This station began services.
  • September 26 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • October 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

East Point Bay is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the North of the East Coast of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-16.

History[]

East Point Bay is the Peninsula of the East Coast of Asylum, and is named East Point Bay because the shape of the bay is shaped like a Cape. To avoid confusion with Winter Point, the Developer of Asylum does not want the station which will be built in this area to use the same name.

Since the first inception of Asylum Development, East Point Bay has been planned to pay homage to the vicinity of the Ma On Shan Promenade. Due to its close proximity with the coast, this district features more Private Housing, which are arranged in the form of stairs and has lower density than more inland areas, with the heights of the buildings descending closer to the coast.

East Ring Line is Line Number 2 of NR Los Sengas Division, and is also a circular line at the east of Los Sengas. This line commenced services on May 25 2015 and formed a complete loop on September 28 2017. With 62 stations along the line, this circular line is longer than the other two circular lines (West Ring Line and Cometsilk Line). Moreover, a branch between Dawn Hill and Rapid Rivulet is set up on this branch, which commenced services on June 5 2020.

Description[]

East Ring Line is a circular line in NR Los Sengas Division, and passes through Downtown, Vector Bay, Oasis, Punctual, Cometsilk, Torrent, Abunest, Yowah, the Egress Continent, the Ingress Sea, Ingress, Glacier, Youngsters District and Sava, before returning to Metropolis Terminal through northeast Three High.

This route is represented by Orange on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 2.

Currently, this route is 97.285 km long, with a total of 62 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S1E6: High Mesa - Pier Cliff
  • S1E15: High Mesa - Kaling Channel
  • S2E7: Youngsters' Spit - Kaling Channel
  • S2E8: Youngsters' Spit - Lower Oasis
  • S2E9: Circle Pit - Lower Oasis
  • S2E10: Circle Pit - Backcomma Beach
  • S2E12: Outcave - Backcomma Beach
  • S2E13: Outcave - Hourglass Bay
  • S2E14: Yowah North - Hourglass Bay
  • S2E15: Metropolis - Metropolis (Loop Complete)
  • S3E11: Branch Line added between Dawn Hill and Rapid Rivulet

Route Establishment (Birth of East Ring Line)[]

While East Ring Line first appeared alongside Metropolis Terminal on March 15 2015, and appeared once again in High Mesa Station due to the establishment of Urban Line on May 24 that year, the route was not connected until May 25, and the first section to commnece services was between High Mesa Station and Kaling Channel Station. At the time, this line was only a short straight line in the urban area and its length was only two-thirds that of Urban Line.

First Extension after years[]

After a year, the expansion of Thick River Station was finally complete, and with the establishment of the south section of Charlie Line, East Ring Line could finally extend, first to Youngsters' Spit Station to the north, and then to Lower Oasis Station, signifying the extension of this line to the rural area. Subsequent development in the Ingress Continent meant that this line extended to Circle Pit Station as well, bringing development to Arcgo Line and Flask Line in the process. Later, establishment of the Oasis Bay Line and development in the Oasis area also meant this East Ring Line could extend to Backcomma Beach Station.

Hiatus[]

As East Ring Line saw continous development upon starting its extension works for 4 consecutive episodes (S2E7 - S2E10), Nazca Railway has decided to pause development of East Ring Line for a month in S2E11 and develop Expo Line, Xofa Line, Origin Line and Fox Line instead, as well as merging the existing Echo Line section with Bravo Line. As a result, East Ring Line did not develop until S2E12.

Works Continue[]

After a month of hiatus, East Ring Line continued its journey towards completion. In chronological order, the Ingress Sea area, Punctual area an Egress Continent, with Ingress Line, New Edward Line and Egress Line being established or extended respectively in the process. Meanwhile, Interisland Line was also established in the WMA area. At that time, ring completion was but a step away (Route at the time: Hourglass Bay Station - Yowah North Station)

Ring Completion[]

After two years of continuous effort, East Ring Line has finally formed a complete loop, with Hourglass Bay Station and Yowah North Station finally being connected, and with Virtel Heights Station being built as a reserved interchange for Stadium Line and Bravo Line. Upon Ring Completion, Xylog Gate Station commenced services.

East Ring Line formed a complete loop on September 28 2017, and the "East Ring Line Completion Ceremony" was held in Outcave Station on October 1 that same year to commemorate this event.

Subsequent Development[]

On S3E11, East Ring Line inserted a branch between Dawn Hill and Rapid Rivulet, which passes through Torrent and Egress Continent. The branch commenced services on June 5 2020, with Daisy Island being built as a reserved interchange for Luxter Line, Origin Line, Fox Line and Kilo Line in the future.

Districts Served[]

The following districts are served along the Inner Ring Direction in the following order:

  • Downtown
    • Three High
    • Kaling Channel
    • Vector Bay
  • Oasis
  • Punctual
  • Cometsilk
    • Silk Pond
    • Gentle Island
  • Torrent
    • Abunest
  • Yowah
    • Flamelute Island
    • Icelute Island
  • Egress
    • Ingress Sea

    • Comrel Island
  • Ingress

    • Polibiomes

It should be noted that the above denotes the order for the Inner Ring Direction. The order is reversed for the Outer Ring Direction.

Line Charcteristics[]

  • A circular line at the east of NRLos Sengas Division. Development is completed on September 28 2017, with the news of ring completion being announced at 14:42 UTC.
  • Currently the longest line in NR at 97.285 km long. It has been holding the record since the establishment of Hourglass Bay Station. At the time, this line was already 58.745 km long and has overtaken West Ring Line as the longest line in NR.
  • Currently the line with the most stations in NR, with up to 62 stations.
  • The first line to complete Upgrading Works upon completion.
  • Adopts characteristics from the East Rail Line of MTR.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Charlie Line (East): Metropolis to Thick River
    • Delta Line (East): Metropolis to Kelper Mount
    • Lima Line (East): Metropolis to Kaling Channel
  • Before the establishment of the first Oceanfloor (Type VII) Station, this line was the only line to have all Station Types.[3]
  • This Line has a crossover track between Kelper Mount and Litchi Lake of New Edward Line for Through Services. Passengers could board the Inner Ring Direction trains and change to stations along the to Le Monde direction, or board New Edward Line trains to the to Hillfield direction at Litchi Lake and change tracks to the Outer Ring Direction of this line. [4][5]

Fun Facts[]

  • Among the six core lines, East Ring Line has seen the slowest development.[6]
  • Origin Pond Station was inserted on East Ring Line (Original development plans for S1E6 did not involve Origin Pond Station).
  • Kaling Channel Station was not involved in the development plans of S1E15, and was instead constructed due to the expansion of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.
  • East Ring Line is the longest line in Nazca Railway, as well as the longest circular line.

As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was formerly the eastbound terminus of Central Line until the establishment of Eternal Line.
  • After the completion of Surrest Station, this station began sharing structures and exit number with that station. As a result, the Exit Number of this station starts with the letter K.
